title: 第11章
content_zh:
笑死人了！端着水杯的陈姐在旁边看朱主任上楼后，突然不阴不阳的开口，说完还用眼角扫了夏真钰一眼。
夏真钰没理会她，直接去找王姐，自己还不知道原因呢，也不能随意接话，王姐看她进来关了办公室的门直接就问：真钰，她们说的是真的？你真和周市长有关系？
什么？这谁造的谣！夏真钰第一反应就是有人胡扯：王姐，这到底怎么回事呀？什么我和周市长，我和他有什么关系啊？我又能和他有什么关系？哪来的闲话，是谁的？
真钰，你也别瞒我，周五你是不是和周瑾宇在一起，还是在酒店里？王姐问得很严肃，这种事可大可小，流言一起任你怎么解释也是徒劳的，要是那种真一门心思不正经的女人也就罢了，还巴不得和周瑾宇能扯上关系呢，可偏偏夏真钰不是那样的人，就是这样才容易受到伤害。
夏真钰吃了一惊，王姐这话代表着周五那天晚上她和周瑾宇在酒店门口争执有人看到了，而且还自行演绎出了整个剧情，难怪朱主任一脸讨好，陈姐阴阳怪气的拿话儿敲打自己。
王姐，那天我只是在酒店门口正好遇到周瑾宇，我和他根本一点关系也没有，话都没说几句。
王姐还是将信将疑：那你没事去酒店做什么？
夏真钰有些尴尬，只能挑能说的说了：我是和我老公去的，和周瑾宇有什么关系。
王姐扑哧笑出了声：你们这些年轻人啊，都结了婚了还去酒店开房间，这成天都想什么呢？
夏真钰不自在的笑了笑，王姐叹了口气说：唉，这真是有嘴也说不清了。周五那天陈秀珍和她爱人，你知道的她老公是区工会主席，一起跟朱主任喝酒看到的，结果今天陈秀珍来得特别早，见人就说那天晚上看见你和周市长拉拉扯扯的从酒店出来，她一个人说还没什么可信度，关键是朱主任也在呢，大家就是不信她，看了朱主任对你的态度也得信了。
看着夏真钰难看的脸色，王姐劝道：这事儿啊你可不能往心里去，你也知道像咱们这样的单位最爱的就是这种小道消息，你就放宽心，过一阵子他们觉得没趣了，也就没事了。
夏真钰当然知道，现在就算是拿出她和李巍一起去酒店的录像，都不能阻止外面的风言风语了，只能挺着，咬牙暗恨周瑾宇误事，可也没办法，虽然出了这种谣言领导只会对自己更加好，不过在同事之间就没那么好相处了，特别是像陈姐那样的人。
做好了心理准备，夏真钰出了王姐的办公室，往信息中心走，沿途有人一脸献媚，有人一副不与其为伍的样子，夏真钰都当没看见，短短的距离今天让夏真钰走得如行千里，总算进了自己的办公室，坐在那想哭也没哭不出来，想发火也发不出来，麻木得很。
这时手机响了，木纳的接起电话，是李巍打来的：真钰，我决定了后天去医院。
作者有话要说：光光一直是现码字，虽然发之前也校对了一遍，可是看了上一章还是有错误的地方，大家见谅光光眼花咧！以后有虫都是这个原因，不解释，嘿嘿！
喜欢这篇文的就收了她，不然要被拖出去调戏的哦(￣▽￣)
☆、我们一起努力
夏真钰听了李巍的决定，连忙打起精神，鼓励他：好，你要是真做好准备了我后天就请假，我们两个一起去。
李巍情绪比较不错：好，一起去。
结束通话夏真钰总算是心里好过了一点，李巍终于肯走出第一步了。

听说夏真钰想请一天假，朱主任恨不得给她一星期带薪假期，夏真钰连连推辞，现在得到的越多，将来发现真像后自己就会越惨，若不是陪李巍去医院这件事太重要了，自己一定不会请假，低调是现在她唯一要做的。
到了周三夏真钰和李巍去了医院，挂了号，看诊时医院还是非常注意病人隐私的，同时也根据患者个人意愿选择是否需要家人在场，李巍让夏真钰留了下来。医生听了二人婚后生活的描述后，又要李巍做了些检测，最后诊断为ＥＤ，李巍听了这个结果整个人都没了生机，呆呆的坐在那。
医生可能也见惯了就诊患者的表现，对于李巍这种表情也没太多意外，仍是和蔼的对夏真钰说：他这种情况还是情况比较乐观的，刚才测试患者生＼理反应基本很正常，估计心理因素占的比重较大。
顿了下又说：你们刚才也说了，患者婚前没有过亲密行为，以他这个年龄如果从未与异＼性在一起过，那么也很容易造成现在这种情况，这个还要你积极配合，千万不能给患者压力，否则不但不会好转，情况还会更加严重。
夏真钰认真听着医生的讲解，着重咨询了自己应该做些什么。
你作为患者的配偶，我们也理解你的压力其实并不比患者来得小，虽然很困难但也请你一定要多多鼓励患者，并多做一些能增加他感官刺＼激的行为，当然不能太刻意，更不能急于求成，暂时我还不会启用药物治疗。
和医生约定了下次的看诊时间，夏真钰和李巍走出了医院，李巍现在沮丧得无以复加，自己感觉是一回事，总可以再抱点幻想和奢望，可是被医生确诊却是毁灭＼性的打击。
夏真钰深深知道，这种病对男人的打击几乎是致命的，不过好在李巍生＼理还算是正常的，主要是多次的挫败一次次加深了他的心理负担，病情才会越来越严重。
夏真钰握着李巍的手说道：李巍，既然我们决定来医院[常的。
李巍苦笑：真钰，你还真是天真，医生不过是往好的方面说罢了，我想死的心都有了。
胡说什么呢！医生又没说治不好，我们慢慢来，我不会给你压力，而且还会帮你分担其他的压力，不用担心只要我们两个人努力，不分心，一切都会好起来的。夏真钰还是很有信心的。
看时间不早了，夏真钰找了间餐馆和李巍一起吃午饭，看着对面的李巍，夏真钰充满了真诚：李巍，其实医生说的我都不怕，我最怕的是你因为这个心理上会越来越不健康，如果你一味的消沉下去，性格总有一天会扭曲的，你明不明白那才是最可怕的情况。
李巍听了闷声说道：这个问题我也想过，我不会变成那样的，真钰你放心好了。
夏真钰微笑着说：你能想到这个就证明你有足够的承受力了，李巍我和你保证只要你能努力坚持下去，无论怎样我们都在一起，好不好？
李巍动容的看着夏真钰，患难夫妻不过如此吧。自己这种情况，真钰还能如此一心为自己着想，丝毫没有考虑她自己的切身利益，也没有说要离开他。得妻如此，夫复何求，他现在真正的感谢老天让他娶到这么好的妻子，自己也应该振作起来，不辜负她的期望。
看李巍眼神又有了光彩，夏真钰知道他还是没有放弃希望的，二人互相对视，眼睛里都有泪光。
经过这一次的患难之情，李巍对夏真钰真正柔情蜜意了起来，嘘寒问暖、百依百顺。既然如此私密的事情都已经和她共享了，那么对李巍来说，夏真钰是这世界上和他关系最亲密的人，因为即使是自己的父母自己也不可能和他们商讨这种事的。
消除了横在两人之间最大的隔阂，李巍真正成了一个好丈夫，除了没有真正的夫妻之实，李巍不断的制造惊喜给夏真钰，什么好东西都第一个想着自己的妻子，夏真钰加班他也会经常来接她下班。
夏真钰单位的同事看了他们夫妻二人这种情况，渐渐的也对陈秀珍说的事情怀疑起来，流言蜚语也少了许多，就连陈秀珍自己也不再阴阳怪气的了。
郭主任又得到通知要去市里汇报阶段性工作，照常要带着夏真钰去，夏真钰却找了理由婉拒了，她不想再与周瑾宇有任何交集，也希望自己这次的举动，能让郭主任他们明白自己和周瑾宇真的没有什么，这样自己会好过许多，她现在得到的所有优待都是沾了她和周瑾宇莫须有关系的光，心理负担很重。

郭主任摸不清状况，而且也听了老朱说的那天看到的情形，所以夏真钰拒绝陪同他还真没敢不同意，带了另一名技术人员去了市里，而且当天可能是会议时间太长，下班时也没回到单位。
第二天上班，夏真钰就听大家议论，说郭主任其实昨天回来了，不过是快八点才回单位，今天助理去他办公室的时候看见主任睡在沙发上呢，看来是一夜都没回家。
这是怎么回事？夏真钰想郭主任的这种表现绝不代表高兴就是了，但就算汇报得不好也不至于不回家呀，想不明白也不去想了，径自去了办公室开始工作。
与此同时，在沙发上一宿没睡的郭怀郭主任，也正坐在办公桌前睁着通红的双眼想不明白，就算昨天自己的汇报有些问题，不过那也是正常的啊，自己去开会不就是为了研讨问题、改进工作吗？何至于被周大市长批得体无完肤，丢尽了几十年的老脸。
更想不通的是以前的几次会议也不是没出过问题，但不也都是轻轻带过，会后改正吗？虽说也是批评了两句，可是面子是留全了的，这次是怎么了？还要自己写自检自查报告，就差全市、全区通报了，自己差点没昏在会议现场，后来还是张处长求了情才抹过去的。
无如何怎么想都觉得自己冤，而且还没头没脑的被损成这样，不敢将错怪在周瑾宇身上，但自己就是死也得做个明白鬼，于是考虑了半天给张处长打了电话。

It’s so funny! Sister Chen, who was holding a water glass, watched Director Zhu go upstairs and suddenly spoke in a nonchalant manner. After speaking, she glanced at Xia Zhenyu from the corner of her eyes.
Xia Zhenyu ignored her and went directly to Sister Wang. She didn't know the reason yet, and she couldn't answer the conversation at will. When Sister Wang saw her coming in and closing the door of the office, she asked directly: Zhenyu, are they telling the truth? Are you really related to Mayor Zhou?
What? Who made this rumor! Xia Zhenyu's first reaction was that someone was talking nonsense: Sister Wang, what on earth is going on? What does Mayor Zhou and I have to do with him? What can I have to do with him? Where does this gossip come from, and who does it belong to?
Zhenyu, don’t hide it from me. Were you with Zhou Jinyu or in the hotel on Friday? Sister Wang asked seriously, whether this kind of thing is big or small, no matter how you explain the rumors, it will be futile. If she is the kind of woman who is really evil-minded, she would like to have a relationship with Zhou Jinyu, but Xia Zhenyu is not that kind of person, and she is easily hurt in this way.
Xia Zhenyu was taken aback. Sister Wang's words meant that someone saw the argument between her and Zhou Jinyu at the hotel door on Friday night, and she acted out the entire plot on her own. No wonder Director Zhu had a flattering look on his face, while Sister Chen slapped herself with some weird words.
Sister Wang, I just happened to meet Zhou Jinyu at the door of the hotel that day. I had no relationship with him at all and we didn't even exchange a few words.
Sister Wang was still doubtful: Then why did you go to the hotel if you had nothing to do?
Xia Zhenyu was a little embarrassed and could only choose what he could say: I went with my husband, what does it have to do with Zhou Jinyu.
Sister Wang burst out laughing: You young people are already married and you go to a hotel to book a room. What do you think about all day long?
Xia Zhenyu smiled uncomfortably, and Sister Wang sighed and said: Alas, I can't even explain this clearly. On Friday, you saw Chen Xiuzhen and her lover, you know her husband is the chairman of the district labor union, drinking with Director Zhu. As a result, Chen Xiuzhen came very early today, and told people that she saw you and Mayor Zhou coming out of the hotel that night, talking about each other. She said it alone is not credible, but the key is that Director Zhu is also there. Everyone just doesn't believe her, but they have to believe it after seeing Director Zhu's attitude towards you.
Looking at Xia Zhenyu's ugly face, Sister Wang advised: "Don't take this matter seriously. You also know that units like ours love this kind of gossip. Just relax. After a while, they will find it boring and it will be fine."
Of course Xia Zhenyu knew that even if she took out the video of her and Li Wei going to the hotel together, it would not stop the rumors outside. She could only stand up and grit her teeth and secretly hate Zhou Jinyu for causing trouble, but there was nothing she could do. Although the boss would only treat her better if such rumors spread, it was not so easy to get along with colleagues, especially people like Sister Chen.
After being mentally prepared, Xia Zhenyu left Sister Wang's office and walked to the information center. Along the way, there were people who looked flattering and others who looked like they were not going to be with them.
At this time, the cell phone rang, and I picked up the call indifferently. It was Li Wei calling: Zhenyu, I decided to go to the hospital the day after tomorrow.

☆. Let’s work together
After hearing Li Wei's decision, Xia Zhenyu quickly cheered up and encouraged him: Okay, if you are really ready, I will ask for leave the day after tomorrow, and we will go together.
Li Wei is in a good mood: Okay, let’s go together.
After ending the call, Xia Zhenyu finally felt a little better, and Li Wei was finally willing to take the first step.
Hearing that Xia Zhenyu wanted to take a day off, Director Zhu wanted to give her a week's paid leave. Xia Zhenyu refused repeatedly. The more she got now, the worse she would be when she discovered the truth in the future. If it wasn't so important to go to the hospital with Li Wei, she would never take leave. Keeping a low profile was the only thing she had to do now.
On Wednesday, Xia Zhenyu and Li Wei went to the hospital and registered. During the consultation, the hospital paid great attention to the patient's privacy. At the same time, it also chose whether family members should be present according to the patient's personal wishes. Li Wei asked Xia Zhenyu to stay. After the doctor listened to the description of their married life, he asked Li Wei to do some tests, and finally diagnosed him with ED. After hearing the result, Li Wei lost his life and sat there blankly.
The doctor may have been used to seeing patients' behavior, so he was not too surprised by Li Wei's expression. He still said to Xia Zhenyu kindly: "His situation is relatively optimistic. The patient's physiological response was basically normal in the test just now. It is estimated that psychological factors account for a larger proportion."
After a pause, he said: As you just said, the patient had no intimate behavior before marriage. At his age, if he had never been with the opposite sex, it would easily lead to the current situation. This requires your active cooperation and must not put pressure on the patient. Otherwise, not only will the patient not get better, but the situation will become more serious.
Xia Zhenyu listened carefully to the doctor's explanation and focused on what he should do.
As the patient's spouse, we also understand that your pressure is actually no less than that of the patient. Although it is very difficult, please encourage the patient more and do more behaviors that can increase his sensory stimulation. Of course, you can't be too deliberate and you can't rush for success. I won't start drug treatment for the time being.
After making an appointment with the doctor for the next consultation, Xia Zhenyu and Li Wei walked out of the hospital. Li Wei was now extremely depressed. He felt that it was the same thing. He could always have more fantasies and extravagant hopes, but being diagnosed by the doctor was a devastating blow.
Xia Zhenyu knew deeply that this disease was almost fatal to men, but fortunately, Li Wei's physiology was still normal. The main reason was that repeated setbacks deepened his psychological burden, and the condition became more and more serious.
Xia Zhenyu held Li Wei's hand and said: Li Wei, since we decided to come to the hospital [Chang's.
Li Wei smiled bitterly: Zhenyu, you are really naive. The doctor only said good things. I already want to die.
What nonsense are you talking about! The doctor didn't say it can't be cured. Let's take it slowly. I won't put pressure on you, and I will also help you share other pressures. Don't worry, as long as the two of us work hard and don't get distracted, everything will be fine. Xia Zhenyu is still very confident.
Seeing that it was getting late, Xia Zhenyu found a restaurant to have lunch with Li Wei. Looking at Li Wei opposite, Xia Zhenyu was full of sincerity: Li Wei, in fact, I am not afraid of anything the doctor said. What I am most afraid of is that you will become more and more unhealthy mentally because of this. If you continue to be depressed, your personality will one day be distorted. Do you understand that that is the most terrifying situation.
Li Wei listened and said in a muffled voice: I have also thought about this problem. I will not become like that. Don't worry, Zhenyu.
Xia Zhenyu smiled and said: The fact that you can think of this proves that you have enough endurance. Li Wei, I promise you that as long as you can work hard and persevere, we will be together no matter what, okay?
Li Wei looked at Xia Zhenyu with emotion, this is just what a couple in need is. In her own situation, Zhenyu could still be so focused on herself, without considering her own vital interests at all, nor did she say she wanted to leave him. After getting a wife like this, what more could a husband ask for? He is now truly grateful to God for allowing him to marry such a good wife. He should also cheer up and live up to her expectations.
lookLi Wei's eyes were shining again, and Xia Zhenyu knew that he still had not given up hope. The two looked at each other with tears in their eyes.
After this time of adversity, Li Wei became truly tender and affectionate towards Xia Zhenyu, asking for help and being obedient. Since such private matters have been shared with her, for Li Wei, Xia Zhenyu is the person closest to him in the world, because even his own parents cannot discuss such a matter with them.
The biggest gap between the two was eliminated, and Li Wei truly became a good husband. Apart from the fact that there was no real relationship between husband and wife, Li Wei constantly created surprises for Xia Zhenyu. He always thought of his wife first for any good things. He would often come to pick Xia Zhenyu up from get off work when she was working overtime.
Colleagues in Xia Zhenyu's unit saw the couple's situation and gradually became suspicious of what Chen Xiuzhen said. The rumors became much less frequent, and even Chen Xiuzhen herself was no longer eccentric.
Director Guo was notified again to go to the city to report on phased work, and he had to take Xia Zhenyu with him as usual, but Xia Zhenyu found a reason to decline. She did not want to have any interaction with Zhou Jinyu anymore, and hoped that her actions this time could make Director Guo and the others understand that she and Zhou Jinyu really had nothing to do with each other. This would make her feel much better. All the preferential treatment she received now was because of her unwarranted relationship with Zhou Jinyu, and the psychological burden was heavy.
Director Guo couldn't figure out the situation, and he also heard what Lao Zhu said about what he saw that day, so he didn't dare to disagree when Xia Zhenyu refused to accompany him. He took another technician to the city, and the meeting might have been too long that day, so he didn't return to the unit after get off work.
When he went to work the next day, Xia Zhenyu heard everyone talking, saying that Director Guo actually came back yesterday, but he only returned to the unit at almost eight o'clock. When the assistant went to his office today, he saw the director sleeping on the sofa. It seemed that he had not been home all night.
What's going on? Xia Zhenyu thought that Director Guo's performance did not mean that he was happy, but even if the report was not good, he would not go home. He didn't think about it anymore and went to the office to start working.
At the same time, Director Guo Huaiguo, who had not slept on the sofa all night, was sitting at his desk with his red eyes open and wondering. Even if there were some problems with his report yesterday, it was normal. Isn't he just going to the meeting to discuss problems and improve his work? How come he was so criticized by Mayor Zhou that he lost all his dignity for decades.
What's even more confusing is that there were no problems in the previous meetings, but weren't they all handled gently and corrected after the meeting? Although he criticized a few words, he saved all face. What happened this time? I still had to write a self-examination report by myself, so I had to report it to the whole city and district. I almost fainted at the meeting, but Director Zhang begged me to erase it later.
No matter how I thought about it, I felt that I was wronged, and I didn't dare to blame Zhou Jinyu for being harmed like this, but I had to be a clear conscience even if I died, so I thought about it for a long time and called Director Zhang.
